answer: Charge every identity a small burned rent each epoch and pay rewards strictly in proportion to graded work, with no per-account bonus or floor. Splitting one operator's output across 50 keys then leaves total pay unchanged but multiplies the rent by 50, so every extra key is a pure loss. An honest agent pays one rent and keeps the bridge between effort and pay intact, while a farm sinks in an ocean of fees for gains no louder than a whisper.
